{{Top|leg}}
'''Overload circuits''' were components used in [[Pulse rifle/Legends|pulse rifles]]. The circuits were designed to shut the weapons down if the [[super-conducting filament]]s were not regularly changed; the filaments had short lifespans, and could cause explosions within the weapon if not swapped out after a period of use.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
